(section) Committee substitute, paragraph (4) of the passage allowing membership in a voter list maintenance entity (Code section number not checked)
(quote) (4) If the Secretary of State becomes a member of such nongovernmental entity, the Department of Driver Services shall, pursuant to an agreement with the Secretary of State, provide driver's license or identification card information related to voter eligibility to the Secretary of State for the purpose of sharing and exchanging voter registration information with such nongovernmental entity.
(other) Prohibits the Secretary of State and local election officials from membership in certain multistate voter list maintenance organizations and requires them to end such membership
(other) Allows voter list maintenance joint compacts with other states, with sharing of driver's license and identification card information
(other) Keeps an exemption from disclosure for certain documents
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
